==Making barbarian mixes==
{{StaticCalculator}}
Barbarian mixes are generally not made as they are rarely traded and may have low value. It is not recommended to make barbarian mixes unless planning to use them. This calculator assumes buying 4 dose potions and decanting them to 2 dose potions as prices of 2 dose potions are less stable.
